'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''

**[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]

*[[Second impeachment of Sara Duterte]]
**The [[Philippine Senate]], sitting as an [[Impeachment in the Philippines|impeachment court]], rules that only senator-judges able to participate count toward the conviction threshold in [[Vice President of the Philippines|vice president]] [[Sara Duterte]]'s trial, reducing the required votes from 16 to 14.
